Kansas Media Rankings polls, 11-man classes, by week, keyed by KPreps slug. Each value is the score the pregame
line uses: 1 + (11 - rank) / 10 for a ranked team (#1 = 2.0, #10 = 1.1), 0.5 for receiving votes.

2024 and 2025 come from Chuck's spreadsheets (2026-10-23); 2026 from the rankings site's own polls. The week 2 poll
is the one that came out after week 1's games, so it goes with week 2's. They were used to set how much a ranking
adds to the line (pb/30-pregame.js, rankPts): the week 2 poll 7 points, every other week none.
